test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An image of a God used for worship
solution: The correct answer is '**Idol**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Idol**'. • It means an image or representation of a god used as an object of worship. (पूजा की वस्तु के रूप में इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली भगवान की छवि या प्रतिनिधित्व)​ • Example - I would never stoop to bow down to a god of stone or an** idol** of wood or jewels. Therefore, the correct answer is** option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Icon**: a person or thing that is considered to be a symbol of something. (किसी वस्‍तु का प्रतीक बना कोई व्‍यक्ति या पदार्थ; प्रतिमा, मूर्ति) • **Model**: a copy of something that is usually smaller than the real thing. [किसी वस्‍तु का नमूना, प्रतिरूप (प्रायः मूल वस्‍तु से छोटा); मॉडल] • **Temple**: a building where people pray to a god or gods. (मंदिर, देवालय, पूजा-स्‍थली) 192:Ta4f, The correct answer is '**Ultimately**'.
